name: Choose the Response Team
description:
An organization detects suspicious logins. It needs someone to triage alerts, correlate logs, and escalate incidents. Which role fits best?

A. SOC analyst

B. UI designer

C. Sales engineer

D. Hardware assembler

Submit `SCSS{letter}` using a lowercase letter.

Submit exactly one flag in `SCSS{...}` format. Flags are case-sensitive.
